optional E2 child install_engine2(E,root), after original config assignment and before original E.main

stages.save: Actual returned analog SID, smiles, mass, sim, shift, NP flag; target mass and spectrum count.
stages.visibility_limit: This result is after analog retrieval filters; it does not expose all library entries before filtering.

stages.behavior: Observe real transformation products before standardisation/key/mass/fingerprint acceptance, without changing parameters.
stages.save: Each actual parent/delta/explicit kwargs and raw returned product SMILES; original derivation exceptions.
stages.visibility_limit: Returned raw products already reflect original transform/budget caps; no unexecuted transforms or counterfactual generation are inferred.

stages.behavior: Original generation acceptance with standardisation, duplicate, mass and fingerprint gates.
stages.save: Accepted product smiles/key/formula/mass/parent/raw/combo, and original E._derlog duplicate rejections.
stages.visibility_limit: Existing rejection log gives duplicate reasons only. Non-duplicate raw-to-accepted losses remain unclassified until offline inspection; never label all missing as a mass failure.

stages.behavior: Pool window10ppm, fallback30ppm only if empty; optional drop_pid; concatenate accepted generated structures.
stages.save: C.pid/key/smiles/formula/mass/is_gen/gen_sim/gen_steps/gen_tan in original row order; target/drop_pid.
stages.visibility_limit: For catalog recall, separately join the immutable full pool offline. C alone cannot distinguish catalog absence from mass-window loss.

stages.save: Candidate row binding, X/F shape/dtype/content SHA, feature names, original rank scores, full candidate rank indices/SMILES, BASE after cell39.
stages.visibility_limit: Record full ranked candidate list before top60; baseline frozen final25 evidence alone cannot measure ranker recall.

stages.save: BASE final order/score/formula slots and pre-popularity actual ranker order.
stages.visibility_limit: Cell-level transition includes both top60 key dedup and popularity; candidate array plus raw rank scores distinguishes losses.

stages.behavior: ICE/GL score union including BASE, E2 and PC candidates.
stages.save: Actual ICE_SCORES/GL_SCORES, scored identities, missing/fallback/model-health status, source score files.
stages.visibility_limit: Dictionary absence is missing model coverage, not a zero score; no proxy/oracle substitution.

stages.save: Pre/post CSV; BASE and PC; pubchem_promotion_audit including leader identity, old/new gate and candidate S/pop/rel.

stages.save: CSV before/after each cell; PREFUSION_LISTS/FUSION_OVERFLOW/BASE_TAIL_CANDIDATES; candidate_audit and experiment_audit.

stages.visibility_limit: Existing e004 postflight cell50 precedes these rules and is not even the nested final, much less full .488.

stages.save: submission_external_control.csv/proposed.csv/final.csv, actual match records, protected/skipped reasons, runtime/audit and source library pins.
stages.visibility_limit: Only after this stage is prediction the exact champion pipeline. AB candidate may be absent from every earlier pool; retain native identity alias and guard behavior.

offline_join.identity: Use pinned official scoring canonicalisation: remove stereo BEFORE tautomer canonicalisation, then IK14. Use same metric_identity/compatible heavy atom guard on truth and candidates; do not substitute raw SMILES, chem.score_key, plain IK14, or full-formula equality.
offline_join.truth_isolation: Production observer never opens truth/labels. Freeze predictions/trace/source+input SHA before separate offline join.
row_binding: raw candidate SMILES and original row index
metrics: candidate recall by all channels and union
ranker recall@25 and rank distribution conditional on candidate presence
official MRR@25 and top1 at exact full-final output
coverage/fallback/error counts; group-balanced bootstrap only after frozen evaluation
error_bins: catalog present but not retrieved or mass-window rejected
raw generated but not accepted (only assign explicit rejection reasons if observed)
candidate present but rank below retained cap
retained candidate lost or demoted at postprocess
offline_join.attribution_boundary: Channels can add candidates late and stages can rescue prior losses. Save all transitions, first loss and final responsible transition; do not force a monotone one-stage decomposition.

acceptance: Observer writes only separate evidence paths; no cfg/threshold/model/parameter changes
Check exact final CSV bytes between observer-on and corresponding observer-off run on same fixed inputs before treating trace as behavioral parity
Actual full production initialization to final AB CSV must finish; smoke/fast_static/components are not full-pipeline success
For panel replay report local official metrics only, never infer a Kaggle score or hidden Class3 prevalence
